name: windmill
description: A traditional Dutch tower mill: a tapering eight-sided brick tower on a stone plinth with a green door and small white-framed windows, a stage (gallery) with railing and braces, a thatched boat-shaped cap that turns about the tower axis (with its tail pole and winding wheel down to the stage, on the same axis), and four lattice sails with furled sailcloth on a slightly tilted axle that spin about their hub.

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the tower (to the underside of the cap) in metres.

params.name: baseRadius
params.description: Radius of the tower at the ground.

params.name: sailLength
params.description: Length of each sail from the hub.
